summary.text: Charles D. Lavine is the incumbent Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represents portions of northeastern Nassau County in the Assembly and chairs the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lavine represents the 13th Assembly District and chairs the Committee on Judiciary; he is also a member of the Codes, Ethics and Guidance, Insurance, and Rules committees.

His official biography says he previously chaired the Election Law Committee, where he led the effort to bring early voting to New York, and the Committee on Ethics and Guidance, and served as co-chair of the New York State Legislative Ethics Commission.

It also says he has sponsored legislation on campaign finance and ethics, firearms, and services for veterans, and that he is president of the New York chapter of the National Association of Jewish Legislators.
